claims.text: The IC² Institute and Dell Medical School announced the AI Learning Lab on October 20th, 2026.
claims.quote: Published October 20, 2026
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The announcement said the lab would launch later that month with 80 Dell Med clinicians.
claims.quote: When the AI Learning Lab launches later this month, 80 Dell Med clinicians
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The 80 participants are a mix of faculty, residents and students who meet patients in simulated encounters.
claims.quote: a mix of faculty, residents, and students — will meet with patients in simulated encounters.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Half of the clinicians get Claude to help diagnose the patient.
claims.quote: Half of the clinicians will have Claude at their fingertips to assist with diagnosing the patient
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The other half rely on UpToDate, a web based medical encyclopedia, with its AI capability switched off.
claims.quote: the other half will be reliant on UpToDate, a web-based medical encyclopedia — with AI capability disabled.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The patients in the encounters are paid actors presenting a medical issue.
claims.quote: The patients (paid actors) will present with a medical issue
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Each clinician questions the patient, pulls the information together and reaches a diagnosis.
claims.quote: the clinicians will meet with the patient, ask questions, synthesize information, and arrive at a diagnosis.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Researchers will compare how both groups reason through a case and look at AI use across experience levels.
claims.quote: Researchers will observe and compare the clinical reasoning processes of both groups and also analyze the use of AI across experience levels.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Researcher Sookja Kang asks how fast participants reach for their AI tool.
claims.quote: How quickly do the clinician participants click on their AI tool?
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Kang also asks whether clinicians take the AI's answer as given or push back on it.
claims.quote: Are they passively accepting AI output or actively interrogating it?
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Kang's third question is how much of the reasoning gets handed to the AI tool as a diagnosis evolves.
claims.quote: How much reasoning work gets handed off to the AI tool, especially as the diagnosis evolves?
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The lab uses a live patient encounter rather than a written case on a page.
claims.quote: the use of a live patient encounter as opposed to a static text vignette.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Researcher Tu-Quyen Dao says solving a real case depends on talking with the patient to gather information.
claims.quote: A large part of solving a real clinical case is interacting with the patient to gather information
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Dell Med's Vice Dean of Education James Korndorffer says AI is going to be used and should be.
claims.quote: We know that AI is going to be, and should be, used.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The release cites a 2026 American Medical Association survey finding 81% of doctors use AI in practice, up from 38% in 2023.
claims.quote: a 2026 American Medical Association survey found that 81% of doctors are using AI in their practice — more than double the 38% reported in 2023.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: Measurement draws on rubrics, observation and an analysis of interviews held after each encounter.
claims.quote: an arsenal of measurements and rubrics as well as observational studies and an analysis of post-encounter interviews.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The release says results could help Dell Med and other schools decide how and when AI enters the curriculum.
claims.quote: Study results could help Dell Med and other institutions refine their approach to how and when they incorporate AI into their curriculum.
claims.document: IC² Institute, IC² Institute, Dell Med Launch AI Learning Lab to Examine AI’s Impact on Clinical Reasoning and Inform Medical Education

claims.text: The project page describes the lab as a joint project of the IC² Institute and Dell Medical School.
claims.quote: The AI Learning Lab is a collaborative project of the IC² Institute and Dell Medical School.
claims.document: IC² Institute, AI Learning Lab: Understanding the Impact of Large Language Models on Clinical Reasoning

claims.text: One stated aim is a taxonomy of the ways clinicians engage with large language models.
claims.quote: Generating a taxonomy of LLM engagement strategies.
claims.document: IC² Institute, AI Learning Lab: Understanding the Impact of Large Language Models on Clinical Reasoning

claims.text: Another stated aim is naming new clinician skills that come from reasoning alongside AI.
claims.quote: Identifying new clinician skills that grow out of AI-augmented clinical reasoning.
claims.document: IC² Institute, AI Learning Lab: Understanding the Impact of Large Language Models on Clinical Reasoning

rejected.reason: The project page states no study dates.
